g.text: MODE_EVT_NEXT works while paused and never changes paused or fault.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16202b

g.text: A fault never changes the mode: scanning carries on so it can recover.

g.text: A mode value out of range goes to MODE_SWEEP on MODE_EVT_NEXT (L32-33).
